projects.name: TRINETRA
projects.summary: Explain the decision. Preserve the payment state.
projects.constraint: A payment must remain retry-safe while every risk decision stays explainable.
projects.decision: Model payment state as a durable ledger and make each risk verdict an auditable transition.
projects.proof: Durable payment state and explainable recovery

projects.name: TRISHUL
projects.constraint: Fraud signals are incomplete, so suspicion cannot be presented as certainty.
projects.decision: Gate every claim through provenance, confidence and a traceable evidence chain.

projects.name: MIRA
projects.constraint: Autonomy without sources or memory becomes opaque and difficult to audit.
projects.decision: Separate discovery, decision, memory and publishing into a visible decision ledger.
projects.proof: Source gates and a visible decision ledger

projects.name: SOCRATES
projects.summary: Find the gap behind a confident explanation.
projects.constraint: A confident answer can still hide shallow understanding or a missed misconception.
projects.decision: Make the learner correct seeded misconceptions against a repeatable evaluation rubric.

projects.name: COUNSELFLOW
projects.summary: Resolve the conflict before locking the list.
projects.constraint: Rank, branch priority, budget and distance can contradict one another before choice lock.
projects.decision: Surface constraint conflicts before producing a deterministic preference order.

projects.name: PAPERTRADE
projects.summary: Keep execution honest when the client drifts.
projects.constraint: Client prices can drift or be manipulated while portfolio state must remain authoritative.
projects.decision: Resolve execution prices on the server and preserve every transaction in the portfolio ledger.
